cohort: 8748 neonates admitted to the NICU/SNCU of Jhalawar Medical College, including 4047 (46.3%) normal birth weight and 4701 (53.7%) low birth weight babies, with 2488 (59.9%) males and 1657 (40.1%) females.
finding: Birth asphyxia (27.36%), neonatal sepsis (18.06%), and neonatal jaundice (15.44%) were the most common morbidities, while hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy/moderate-to-severe birth asphyxia (28.23%), neonatal sepsis (20.62%), respiratory distress syndrome (19.35%), and major congenital malformations (7.24%) were the most common causes of death.
birth_weight: low birth weight, normal birth weight
